verification_status: Native 8, PTX 4, selected related regression 5, fast 100, legacy full module 5, normal API 3 routes and two raw preview squads passed; current source and binary hashes verified.
source: Pinned calculator BuffManager activation, effective_max_hp and expiry branches; parsed skill definition. Explicit reference model, not an independently measured game rule.

external_evidence.scope: Client-data skill description supports caster final maximum HP as the quantity basis and 10-second duration at the stated level.

external_evidence.author: Valkkin
external_evidence.scope: Guide explicitly describes current HP increasing by the same amount as maximum HP on burst activation.
external_evidence.limits: Does not independently establish refresh, stack, simultaneous-expiry or all down/revival interactions. Those remain the explicit reference model.

activation: Read full current stack value at activation.
Remove this live instance's old flat HP gift before measuring source effective maximum HP.
Store source effective maximum HP times value percent as an absolute quantity.
Subsequent source HP changes do not resize this quantity until reapplication.
Only positive change from the previous snapshot increases recipients' current HP; cap by effective maximum and synchronize HP conditions. A decreasing snapshot does not itself remove current HP.
lifetime: Fresh instances start with zero previous snapshot.
Reapplication replaces the snapshot; do not compound the instance's own old gift on the source.
Expiry delivers existing state-end notification before clamping recipient current HP to the new maximum.
Keep existing generic target membership, down and revival transitions.
state: CPU uses the same ActiveBuff in RuntimeState.pool. GPU uses type-guarded existing shield_capacity[slot][0] for the fixed quantity and shield_current[slot][0] for activation delta; code 84 is never a shield. No new allocation or character-name execution branch.
execution: Register lifecycle activation in lifecycle_specs.py; use generated CUDA dispatch and existing ordered health continuation. Numerical snapshot handler and expiry code run on GPU.
targets: Synchronous allied targets only. Enemy, lazy ranked and ordered target-list forms are rejected by the compiler and validated program boundary. These forms need explicit snapshot timing semantics before acceptance.
independent_cases: Source HP buff, repeated self-including refresh without compounding, live source growth, fresh recapture and expiry
Stack increases, capped refresh and expiry
Source and recipient separated, source maximum-only growth versus current growth
squad_cases: Repeated snapshots plus HP-derived ATK, shield snapshots and maximum-HP healing
Simultaneous expiry of source HP and multiple snapshot carriers
Raw skill definitions with default growth
Raw skill definitions with edited growth and reordered positions
verification_reuse: Reuse existing whole-squad survival/scaling comparator and all its per-frame HP, damage, burst, control, HP-event and RNG checks. Add positive activation witnesses based on the common stat, not a character-specific assertion branch. Native covers three independent plus five squad cases; PTX covers three independent plus one raw squad case.
